Read me.Decision or instruction: Only Pusa and Shahdara; Year 1 new intake. No continuing Year 2 learners.
Pusa 1088 students / 1536 places; Shahdara 476 / 672. Core trade and Other totals are preserved.
Read me.Basis: Delhi SIP data v1.0 Course annual plan

Read me.Decision or instruction: Pusa 776 and Shahdara 249 split among named assumed legacy trades. These are not verified institute offerings.
Automation robotics, drones, advanced welding and all later specialist programmes have no records in this release.
Pusa 76 and Shahdara 33 retained at user request. No staffing-ratio claim. Principals and CEO are separate accounts.
Read me.Basis: SIP trainer plan; user retained pending revision

Read me.Decision or instruction: Intake 01-08-2025; roster snapshot 04-08-2025. Planning Year 1 is FY2025-26; first study year ends 31-07-2026.
Read me.Basis: Scenario assumption; not actual admission dates

Read me.Decision or instruction: 12 or 24 months are prototype settings. Two-year course end dates in 2027 do not create second-year learner records.
Core batches: 20 seats. Other batches: combinations of 20 and 24, keeping exact SIP capacity totals.
Read me.Basis: Prototype configuration; not a sanctioned intake norm

Read me.Decision or instruction: Stable synthetic IDs; all names and contacts newly generated. Existing rows from the uploaded Excel are not reused.
Emails use example.invalid; phones start 000 and remain text. Do not use these for live messaging or OTP.
Aadhar_No remains blank for every faculty member.
Read me.Basis: Prototype does not require real government identity

Read me.Decision or instruction: Delhi is the setting; district lookup entries are synthetic planning areas. Coordinates and landlines remain blank.
Read me.Basis: No claim of official administrative coding

Read me.Decision or instruction: 1564 unique fictional people and 1564 course enrolments in this release. All begin in Study Year 1.
235 female and 1329 male learners; approximate 15% Y1 target. Ages 18-25 at intake. Other profile details are illustrative.
Read me.Basis: Synthetic allocation independent of actual people

Read me.Decision or instruction: Four required Year 1 subject components per programme. They are illustrative, not a certified curriculum.
A single trainer can have several subject/batch assignments. Faculty tab stores one primary assignment; assignment table is authoritative for access.
No timetable, daily attendance, camera observations, marks or placement outcomes have been fabricated in this registry release.
Read me.Basis: Next stage uses these stable IDs

Read me.Decision or instruction: Companion enrolments and faculty index are keyed extracts of the upload registry, generated from the same dataset. Regenerate both files together after changes.
Delhi_Synthetic_SIP_and_AOP_Data_v1.0.xlsx: Course annual plan and ITIs sheets.
Updated Higher Attendance Bot 9 Oct 2026 (1).xlsx: first-row headers and field instructions only.
Read me.Basis: Import structure; no source person records

Read me.Decision or instruction: PM SETU PRD (1)(1).md: shared data, attendance, roles and implementation inputs.
PUS/SHA and ELE/FIT/COP are existing SIP IDs; new legacy courses use L-prefixed codes. Each Other child retains its original SIP anchor.
State and District; Institute; Programs; Batch; Faculty and Student; supporting assignments and user access.
